stops.name: Bergisches Land Nature Park
stops.detail: The valuable natural and cultural landscape, the healthy climate as well as the cultural and biological diversity make the Bergisches Land Nature Park a living and experience area with unique quality. The area stretches from Cologne (west) to the Sauerland (east) or from the Wupper river (north) and to the Sieg river (south). The nature park is one of Germany's National Natural Landscapes. Nature parks are committed to sustainable regional development. They preserve and develop nature and landscape with and for people.
